about: Repeat buying after a late first order (90-day window). Copied from the read-only analysis in /workspace/olist-repeat (results.json, built on this warehouse at 63279ec). story/check_story.py ties these counts to evidence/recommendation_report.json and checks the story's repeat sentence against them.
story_sentence: Customers whose first order arrived late were somewhat less likely to order again (about 1.0% vs 1.3% within 90 days), but repeat buying on Olist is so rare that this gap is too small to measure reliably, and fixing lateness would be worth at most a few thousand reais in repeat sales, so we make no revenue claim.
